name: map_version_major
description: Register map major version. Changes when anything moves or changes meaning

name: map_version_minor
description: Register map minor version. Changes when fields are added in reserved space

name: protocol_ver
description: LoRa protocol VER implemented (00 section 5). v1 = 1

name: fw_version
description: Master firmware version: high byte major, low byte minor

name: fw_build
description: Master firmware build number

name: gateway_role
description: 0 = master. Other values reserved

name: boot_count
description: Number of boots since manufacture

name: uptime_s
description: Seconds since boot

name: utc
description: Master clock, Unix time UTC

name: tz_offset_min
description: Active local-time offset from UTC

name: clock_state
description: 0 = untrusted (lights-ON rule applies), 1 = holdover on RTC (not set by server for > 24 h), 2 = trusted (set by server within 24 h)

name: reset_cause
description: Cause of last reset: 0 power-on, 1 brown-out, 2 watchdog, 3 software (REBOOT or update), 4 pin reset, 5 fault handler, 0xFFFF unknown

name: heartbeat
description: Increments by 1 every second, wraps at 65535. A value that stops changing means a frozen gateway

name: telemetry_epoch
description: Increments (wrapping) whenever any telemetry value in the section, meter, summary or device areas changes. Age counters do not bump it

name: section_mask
description: Active section mask: bit s set = section s configured (bits 1-14). Bit 0 and 15 always 0

name: devices_configured
description: Devices authorised across all sections (LED devices + meters)

name: devices_online
description: Devices whose summary state is online

name: devices_faulted
description: Devices with driver_fault, lamp_fault or DALI not OK

name: lamps_on
description: Devices with lamp_on set

name: fault_bitmap
description: Master fault bits, see spec 01 section 6.2

name: net_id
description: Active NetID (1-254)

name: cycle_s
description: Active cycle length

name: cycle_seq
description: Tier-1 cycle sequence number (wraps)

name: airtime_used_ds
description: Master transmit time used in the last rolling hour, all radios

name: airtime_used_pct
description: Master airtime used as a share of the 36 s hourly budget

name: cpu_temp_c
description: MCU die temperature

name: vdd_mv
description: MCU supply voltage

name: store_forward_depth
description: Events held unacknowledged in the master buffer (RAM + NOR)

name: tier1_active_radio

name: tier1_failover_count

name: tier1_failover_state

name: tier1_last_failover_utc

name: jobs_queued
description: Command jobs waiting in the master queue (max 8)

name: jobs_settling
description: Dispatched jobs still collecting confirmations

name: radio_a_health

name: radio_a_channel

name: radio_a_sf

name: radio_a_tx_power_dbm

name: radio_a_tx_fail

name: radio_a_rx_ok

name: radio_a_rx_crc_err

name: radio_a_rx_mic_fail

name: radio_a_last_rssi_dbm
description: radio A (tier-1 primary): RSSI of last valid frame

name: radio_a_last_snr_qdb
description: radio A (tier-1 primary): SNR of last valid frame

name: radio_a_noise_floor_dbm
description: radio A (tier-1 primary): Noise floor sampled in idle time

name: radio_b_health
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): 0 OK, 1 degraded (PER above threshold), 2 failed, 3 not fitted

name: radio_b_channel
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Configured channel number (spec 04 section 2)

name: radio_b_sf
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Spreading factor in use (7-9)

name: radio_b_tx_power_dbm
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Configured conducted TX power

name: radio_b_tx_ok
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Frames transmitted (TxDone)

name: radio_b_tx_fail
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Transmissions that failed (timeout, SPI error, refused by airtime ledger)

name: radio_b_rx_ok
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Frames received with valid PHY CRC

name: radio_b_rx_crc_err
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Frames received with PHY CRC error

name: radio_b_rx_mic_fail
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Frames dropped for MIC or replay failure (wraps)

name: radio_b_last_rssi_dbm
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): RSSI of last valid frame

name: radio_b_last_snr_qdb
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): SNR of last valid frame

name: radio_b_noise_floor_dbm
description: radio B (tier-1 standby): Noise floor sampled in idle time

name: mb_rx_frames
description: Modbus requests received addressed to this unit

name: mb_crc_errors
description: Modbus frames dropped for CRC error (wraps)

name: mb_exceptions
description: Exception responses sent (wraps)

name: mb_last_exception
description: Code of the last exception sent (0 = none)

name: mb_last_poll_age_s
description: Seconds since the previous valid request before this one

name: sec_section_state
description: Master view of the section: 0 not configured, 1 SYNCED, 2 DEGRADED, 3 AUTONOMOUS, 4 CLOCK_UNTRUSTED, 5 REJOINING, 6 LOST (no SUMMARY for 3 cycles)

name: sec_age_s
description: Seconds since the last SUMMARY from this slave. 0xFFFF = never

name: sec_section_flags
description: bit0 single-channel mode, bit1 up radio A OK, bit2 up radio B OK, bit3 down radio A OK, bit4 down radio B OK, bit5 slave using standby uplink, bit6 commissioning window open, bit7 config mismatch with master

name: sec_devices_configured
description: Devices authorised in this section

name: sec_devices_online
description: Devices reporting normally

name: sec_lamps_on
description: Devices with lamp_on set

name: sec_faults
description: Devices with any fault bit set

name: sec_power_w
description: Aggregate section power (meter if present, else sum of devices)

name: sec_energy_wh
description: Section energy, cumulative (meter if present, else sum of devices)

name: sec_config_hash
description: Hash of the slave's active configuration

name: sec_clock_offset_ms
description: Slave clock minus master clock at the last SUMMARY

name: sec_airtime_used_pct
description: Slave airtime used in the last hour as a share of its budget

name: sec_slotmap_ver
description: Slave slot-map version (low byte significant)

name: sec_last_rssi_dbm
description: RSSI at the master of the last frame from this slave

name: met_state
description: 0 no meter configured, 1 online, 2 stale, 3 offline

name: met_age_s
description: Seconds since the meter data was measured. 0xFFFF = never

name: met_address
description: 12-bit protocol address of the meter (spec 00 section 3)

name: met_status
description: Device status bits (spec 01 section 6.4)

name: met_v_l1
description: Voltage L1-N (L1-L2 on delta)

name: met_v_l2
description: Voltage L2-N (L2-L3 on delta)

name: met_v_l3
description: Voltage L3-N (L3-L1 on delta)

name: met_i_l1
description: Current L1

name: met_i_l2
description: Current L2

name: met_i_l3
description: Current L3

name: met_i_n
description: Neutral current

name: met_p_l1
description: Active power L1

name: met_p_l2
description: Active power L2

name: met_p_l3
description: Active power L3

name: met_p_total
description: Total active power

name: met_pf_total
description: Total power factor

name: met_freq
description: Frequency

name: met_e_import
description: Active energy import, cumulative

name: met_e_export
description: Active energy export, cumulative

name: met_thd_i
description: Current THD (average of phases)

name: met_meter_flags
description: bit0 wye (1) / delta (0), bit1 CT-connected, bit2 phase loss L1, bit3 phase loss L2, bit4 phase loss L3

name: met_fault_code
description: Meter fault code (spec 03), 0 = none

name: sum_device
description: Packed device summary: bits 0-7 level_actual, bits 8-9 comm state (0 not configured, 1 online, 2 stale, 3 offline), bit10 lamp_on, bit11 fault (driver_fault or lamp_fault or DALI not OK), bit12 fallback_mode, bit13 override_active, bit14 commanded_off, bit15 config_mismatch. NodeID 0 is the gateway slot and always reads 0

name: ev_oldest_seq
description: Sequence number of the first event in the window (oldest unacknowledged)

name: ev_window_count
description: Valid events in the window (0-32)

name: ev_pending_total
description: Unacknowledged events held by the master, window included

name: ev_dropped
description: Events lost to buffer overflow since boot (wraps)

name: ev_seq
description: Event sequence number (wraps; compare modulo 65536). Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8; slot 0 is the oldest

name: ev_utc
description: Time the event happened at its source. Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8; slot 0 is the oldest

name: ev_source
description: 12-bit protocol address of the source (spec 00 section 3). Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8; slot 0 is the oldest

name: ev_code
description: Event code. 0x0000-0x7FFF = codes carried from radio EVENT frames (specs 02 and 03), 0x8000-0xFFFF = generated by the master (spec 01 section 7.3). Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8; slot 0 is the oldest

name: ev_arg1
description: First event argument (code-specific). Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8; slot 0 is the oldest

name: ev_arg2
description: Second event argument (code-specific). Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8; slot 0 is the oldest

name: ev_severity
description: 0 info, 1 warning, 2 alarm, 3 critical. Event slot i (0-31) is at 0x0810 + i*8

name: dev_status
description: Device status bits (spec 01 section 6.4)

name: dev_age_status_s
description: Seconds since the master last confirmed this device's status. 0xFFFF = never

name: dev_level_actual
description: Output level reported by the device: DALI arc 0-254, 255 unknown

name: dev_level_commanded
description: Level the device is trying to hold (schedule or override): DALI arc 0-254, 255 unknown

name: dev_power_dw
description: Device input power

name: dev_voltage_dv
description: Supply voltage at the device

name: dev_current_ma
description: Supply current

name: dev_energy_wh
description: Device energy, cumulative

name: dev_temp_c
description: Device temperature

name: dev_lamp_hours
description: Lamp burning hours

name: dev_fault_code
description: Device fault code (spec 03), 0 = none

name: dev_rssi_snr
description: Link quality at the slave: high byte RSSI (int8, dBm), low byte SNR (int8, 0.25 dB)

name: dev_slot_channel
description: High byte slot position 0-63 (0xFF none), low byte radio channel number in use (spec 04)

name: dev_age_detail_s
description: Seconds since the power, energy and extended fields were measured. 0xFFFF = never

name: diag_summary_rx
description: SUMMARY frames received from this slave

name: diag_summary_missed
description: Tier-1 slots in which no SUMMARY arrived

name: diag_last_snr_qdb
description: SNR at the master of the last frame from this slave

name: diag_uplink_radio
description: Slave uplink radio in use: 0 A (primary), 1 B (standby)

name: diag_detail_records_rx
description: DETAIL records received from this slave

name: diag_cmd_frames_tx
description: CMD frames sent to this slave (wraps)

name: diag_cmd_retries
description: CMD retransmissions to this slave (wraps)

name: diag_events_rx
description: EVENT frames received from this slave (wraps)

name: diag_slave_fw_version
description: Slave firmware version (high byte major, low byte minor), 0 = unknown

name: cfg_unit_id
description: Modbus unit ID, 1-247. Default 1. Takes effect after reboot

name: cfg_baud_code
description: 0 = 9600, 1 = 19200 (default), 2 = 38400, 3 = 57600, 4 = 115200. Takes effect after reboot

name: cfg_parity_code
description: 0 = none with 2 stop bits, 1 = even (default, 8E1), 2 = odd. Takes effect after reboot

name: cfg_net_id
description: Site NetID, 1-254

name: cfg_latitude
description: Site latitude, positive north

name: cfg_longitude
description: Site longitude, positive east

name: cfg_tz_offset_min
description: Local time offset from UTC. Default +480

name: cfg_dusk_offset_min
description: Switch-on time relative to computed sunset (negative = earlier)

name: cfg_dawn_offset_min
description: Switch-off time relative to computed sunrise (positive = later)

name: cfg_cycle_s
description: Cycle length: 120 (default), 180 or 300. 60 only if NTC confirms a per-radio duty budget (spec 04)

name: cfg_section_mask
description: Configured sections: bit s = section s (bits 1-14)

name: cfg_t1_primary_ch
description: Tier-1 primary channel number. Default 0

name: cfg_t1_standby_ch
description: Tier-1 standby channel number. Default 13

name: cfg_t1_sf
description: Tier-1 spreading factor, 7 (default) or 8

name: cfg_radio_a_tx_dbm
description: Radio A conducted TX power. Must keep EIRP at or below 16 dBm

name: cfg_radio_b_tx_dbm
description: Radio B conducted TX power. Must keep EIRP at or below 16 dBm

name: cfg_cell_sf
description: Default cell spreading factor pushed to slaves, 7-9. Default 9

name: cfg_stale_threshold_s
description: Age after which device data counts as stale. Default 360

name: cfg_stale_policy
description: 0 = return value plus age (default), 1 = return not-available sentinel for stale values, 2 = exception 0x0B on reads of a stale device block

name: cfg_fc03_mirror
description: 1 = input space mirrored at holding 0x8000 + address (default), 0 = off

name: cfg_detail_interval_min
description: Interval for full device detail on tier 1. Default 15

name: cfg_power_on_level
description: DALI POWER ON LEVEL pushed to drivers. Default 254

name: cfg_system_failure_level
description: DALI SYSTEM FAILURE LEVEL pushed to drivers. Default 254

name: cfg_sync_word
description: LoRa sync word (low byte). Default 0x12, never 0x34

name: cfg_p0_reserve_pct
description: Share of the hourly airtime budget reserved for P0. Default 25

name: cfg_dim_step1_minute
description: Site default dimming step 1: local minute of day 0-1439 at which the step starts, 0xFFFF = unused

name: cfg_dim_step1_level
description: Site default dimming step 1: level (DALI arc 0-254)

name: cfg_dim_step2_minute
description: Site default dimming step 2: local minute of day 0-1439 at which the step starts, 0xFFFF = unused

name: cfg_dim_step2_level
description: Site default dimming step 2: level (DALI arc 0-254)

name: cfg_dim_step3_minute
description: Site default dimming step 3: local minute of day 0-1439 at which the step starts, 0xFFFF = unused

name: cfg_dim_step3_level
description: Site default dimming step 3: level (DALI arc 0-254)

name: cfg_dim_step4_minute
description: Site default dimming step 4: local minute of day 0-1439 at which the step starts, 0xFFFF = unused

name: cfg_dim_step4_level
description: Site default dimming step 4: level (DALI arc 0-254)

name: cfg_commit
description: Write 0xA5C3 to validate and apply all written config registers at once. Any other value: exception 0x03. Reads 0

name: cfg_status
description: 0 applied (nothing pending), 1 pending (written, not committed), 2 applying, 3 rejected (see cfg_error_reg), 4 applied, reboot needed for serial settings

name: cfg_error_reg
description: Address of the first register that failed validation at the last commit. 0xFFFF = none

name: cfg_version
description: Increments on each successful commit
